signal: Velocity Automotive was acquired by Vehlo Holdings in February 2025, joining its automotive software portfolio alongside Rapid Recon.

email.body1:
Harrison, saw Velocity Automotive joined Vehlo's portfolio alongside Rapid Recon last year.

Folding into a bigger platform usually opens more dealer accounts than the regional team can cover before reps are stretched, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Velocity off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Harrison, quick follow-up for Velocity.

Inside a larger group, territory expectations usually grow faster than headcount, and most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit target this quarter. So the gap shows up late, and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Harrison, last bit of proof for Velocity.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Velocity's reply rate likely compares to other dealer-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Harrison, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority while you integrate into Vehlo, no problem at all. Timing matters after an acquisition, and I know it keeps a regional team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Velocity either way.
